abstract: Serve one LLM across several machines with tensor, pipeline, data and expert parallelism. Covers vLLM (Ray and multiprocessing), SGLang, TensorRT-LLM over MPI/SLURM, llama.cpp RPC, exo and TensorFold speed-up mode, the NCCL, ConnectX-7, RoCE and InfiniBand interconnect, and a DGX Spark dual-node example, with exact flags, defaults, constraints, a fabric verification procedure and a numerics gate via llm-evals. References are split into an engine matrix and an interconnect guide.
